There are 57 closest valid design counterparts and 23 views with no matching saved design screen/state found. Preference decisions remain yours.
# How to review

Select a comparison heading or its review text and add a comment. Include the comparison ID when using Add to chat. You can state Prefer Sketch, Prefer app, Combine, or Additional changes, followed by the specific changes you want.

# Capture baseline

The app is a Release simulator rebuild of the verified TestFlight 1.0.0 (32) source revision [c2301c2e](https://github.com/eslutz/A-Playa-Named-Gus/commit/c2301c2e16cc7841368cbb65b8d4cd4e31d29992). All 302 release source fingerprints and the dependency lockfile match. The installed bundle reports version 1.0.0 and build 32; the final build completed with zero warnings and errors.

Captures use an isolated iPhone 17 simulator on iOS 27.0, a 402 × 874 point viewport, light appearance, default text size, and gus-demo-jellyfin. Original screenshots are retained at 1206 × 2622 pixels. These are simulator captures, not captures of a TestFlight device binary.

Sketch baseline: [R5 Light — eeGbj2](https://www.sketch.com/s/5d22768f-8a13-470f-badd-0de9f9dec51c/v/eeGbj2), the latest recorded checkpoint. Fresh 3× exports were made in Sketch 2026.3.1 from a separate copy of the preserved snapshot. Live cloud history could not be independently refreshed because the browser was signed out. Original designs remain unchanged.

System appearance was Light throughout. The app initially followed System and was later explicitly set to Light. Native player and photo-viewer canvases remain black. Artwork, titles, metadata, counts and available services differ between the design fixtures and demo media; the notes distinguish these from layout differences. Closest counterparts with different states or scroll positions are identified explicitly.
# Coverage notes

The report follows screens implemented in Build 32. Sketch-only designs are excluded. A missing Sketch counterpart will be labeled explicitly. A screen that exists in the app but cannot be reached with the available demo services will be listed separately as a capture limitation.

The reconciled inventory contains 120 entries: 80 captured views, 4 controls covered within those views, and 36 explicit capture limitations listed at the end. This is a screen/state inventory, not every possible data or error permutation. GUS-052 is intentionally absent because an attempted AirPlay capture duplicated the audio player.
